changes.title: Keep rounded statistical lower bounds conservative
changes.text: Display a known minimum of 2.46 as >=2.4 instead of incorrectly claiming >=2.5.

changes.title: Check rounded positive and negative statistical bounds

commentary: I corrected rounding for statistics marked as lower bounds so the display does not overstate what is known. Recorded values and normal rounding for exact results are preserved.
